payloads.description: Single-quote probe to break out of a string literal and trigger a syntax error.
Double-quote probe for engines that quote identifiers/strings with double quotes.
Backtick probe for MySQL identifier quoting.
Always-true condition with trailing comment to swallow the rest of the query.
Always-true condition escaping a parenthesised clause.
Numeric-context true condition for differential comparison.
Numeric-context false condition for differential comparison.
Comment out the password check after a known username.
Open an inline comment to neutralise the rest of the WHERE clause.
MySQL time-based blind injection using SLEEP().
MySQL time-based blind via derived-table subquery (works where bare SLEEP is filtered).
MySQL time-based blind escaping a parenthesised numeric parameter.
MSSQL time-based blind via stacked WAITFOR DELAY.
SQLite time-based blind by forcing heavy CPU work (no sleep primitive).
MySQL UNION version leak wrapped in tilde delimiters.
MySQL error-based extraction via XPath function extractvalue().
MSSQL error-based extraction via type-conversion failure.
PostgreSQL error-based extraction via CAST failure.
MySQL versioned-comment UNION to slip past keyword filters.
Mixed-case keywords defeat case-sensitive regex signatures.
Inline comments replace whitespace to break tokenised signatures.
Vertical-tab (0x0b) as whitespace where the WAF only normalises spaces/tabs.
E-notation number glued to UNION so no whitespace/keyword boundary is seen.
JSON function syntax that many WAFs do not parse (Picus JSON-SQLi class).
PostgreSQL jsonb ->> operator SQLi outside typical WAF grammars.
MSSQL out-of-band exfil trigger via xp_dirtree UNC lookup to a marker host.
Stacked-query DDL. Destructive: only runs with --allow-destructive.
